ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant central contiguous black region spanning most of both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white geometric blobs are located at the lateral distal tips. Two small, isolated circular white-ring markers are visible in the lower-central region of each lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Sharp V-shaped central depression with an estimated interior angle of 55-65 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant jagged peaks and deep valleys are concentrated at the far right lobe tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the primary span of both lobes, transitioning to a slight concave dip near the distal lateral edges.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density clusters of circular, textured, high-contrast white pixel groups (consistent with barnacle colonization) located exclusively on the distal lateral tips of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, unaligned linear white pixel disruptions visible on the inner regions of both lobes, most prominently on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Two highly distinct, roughly circular white-ring scars located symmetrically on the lower-mid portion of each fluke lobe. Significant textural anomalies at the tips caused by biological encrustation.
other_distinctive_markers: A large, irregular white patch on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe containing several small dark pixel voids.
